subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a non-USD model-cost currency contract, and should it be per-model, per-provider, or a global display preference?
rationale: The request is useful, but current source and docs define model costs as USD and repository policy sets a high bar for new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement a single documented currency field with USD default and tests across config, registry, and UI displays.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Reject a new model-cost currency surface and direct non-USD provider balances through the existing provider usage/billing-unit path.

options.title: Make it display-only
options.body: Treat currency as a user display preference rather than provider/model metadata, accepting that it does not change numeric cost semantics.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement a single documented currency field with USD default and tests across config, registry, and UI displays.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent UI cost-formatting history points to vincentkoc, and the decision is primarily about how the UI/config contract should represent cost currency.
